notes.title: 《Cinderia》demo V0.4.3 Update
notes.notes:
Update
Health potions in the shop now display healing value

Added Skill icons for Tiny Green

Added fishing event animation for Tiny Green

Frost Assault no longer affects dash attacks




BUG Fix
Fixed a bug that could cause a UI error and freeze when returning home after multiple playthroughs

Fixed incorrect text on the confirm button in the English version

Fixed an issue where the brazier could disappear after loading a save

Fixed an issue where normal attacks could trigger repeatedly after changing zones in certain situations

Fixed mismatched button prompts and actual input for fishing in controller mode

Fixed an issue where switching to Tiny Red could result in duplicate characters

Fixed a bug where the character could appear outside the map after clearing a stage

Fixed abnormal upgrade effects for Soul Companion and Nest Seizure

Fixed an issue where special effects would not refresh immediately after obtaining the Nut Shell

Fixed an issue where switching to Tiny Red after full unlock could result in two same characters

Fixed Lightning Chain sound effect on Yellow not being affected by volume settings

Fixed English text not updating after upgrading Frost Aftershock

Fixed unlocked out-of-combat talents not taking effect immediately

Fixed repeated animation playback after resurrection

Fixed some texts not switching properly when changing language from English to Chinese

Fixed an issue where keybindings could not be changed in-game

Fixed Howling Hurricane losing its effects after multiple casts

Fixed Howling Hurricane not being able to cast early

Fixed Tiny Blue Ice Storm dragon flickering issue

Adjusted the width of  Tiny Blue Frost Breath indicator

Fixed Tiny Blue Horn Strike not working properly

Fixed an issue where the character could remain with eyes closed for an extended period

notes.title: 《Cinderia》Demo Version Update V0.3.3B
notes.notes:
【Optimization!】
This update focuses on a variety of mysterious performance optimizations related to spine animations and game scenes.
If you notice any animations tearing or suddenly disappearing in-game, don’t panic... just report the bug!
[hr][/hr]【Controller Support】
Controller input has been slightly reworked. The new setup is now partially implemented but still under adjustment.

We’re currently experimenting with controller interactions.
The first version will likely use combo buttons for active skills.
Later, we’ll add a second default layout using single buttons, as well as custom remapping (ETA: maybe in a month?).
[hr][/hr]【Other Changes】
Slight adjustment to character dashes:
→ Little Blue's dash count increased from 1 → 2

Some item and skill values have been tweaked.

As the game is still in early development, balance changes are happening frequently and may not always be documented in detail. More thorough patch notes will be provided in future updates.
[hr][/hr]【Bug Fixes】
Fixed a bug where re-picking the Giant Beanstalk would repeatedly trigger its effects

Fixed incorrect text descriptions for some items

Fixed an issue where stealth did not prevent some enemy tracking skills

Fixed main menu UI sound effects stacking incorrectly

Fixed a bug causing the character to flip mirror-style while fishing

Fixed camera reset issues under certain conditions

Fixed a bug where thrown knives would incorrectly appear as shurikens when a throwing talent was active

Fixed an issue where Little Blue would lose HP when activating Frost Sweep while having "All-Out Charge" and "Frost Sweep" at the same time

Fixed VFX issues for Little Blue’s Frost Flurry

Fixed a bug where Little Red’s “Desolation” didn’t actually increase shadow damage

Fixed Light Torch’s activation timing being inconsistent with its description

Fixed incorrect text description for the Giant’s Axe

Fixed HP bonus display bug for Giant Beanstalk

Fixed an exploit where Soulmoth Lantern could heal infinitely

Fixed incorrect effect trajectories for Soulmoth Lantern

Fixed a bug where Soulmoth Lantern effects would wrongly fly to summoned units

Fixed Soulmoth Lantern triggering when summons disappeared

Fixed a bug where Little Yellow’s “Heavy Strike” also inflicted Cripple

Fixed Mermaid’s Tear effects not being removed with Curse Purge

Fixed a bug where the first use of the grappling hook would launch backward

Fixed a bug where enemy mobs didn’t die with the boss

Fixed infinite shop refresh issue when using controller

Fixed an invisible wall in Chapter 3 that could only be crossed from below

...and other minor issues



Since it’s translated by GPT, feel free to ask if anything seems unclear or ambiguous...
